visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four anthropomorphic dogs, appearing to be Pugs or French Bulldogs, are positioned in a line on a paved urban pedestrian street. They are wearing black bob-style wigs and Japanese school uniforms consisting of white shirts, black neckbands, and gray pleated skirts. The background features a vibrant city scene with red pillars and a large overhead banner with text. The dogs sway their bodies and move their limbs in a synchronized, rhythmic fashion against a bright, natural daylight setting. (2) The camera remains at eye level as the four dogs transition into a more complex set of dance moves. They raise their paws high above their heads in unison before bringing them down to their sides in a repetitive motion. Their facial expressions are fixed in a happy, tongue-out panting look throughout the sequence. The urban background remains static with pedestrians blurred in the far distance, emphasizing the CGI nature of the central subjects. (3) The camera performs a slow digital zoom toward the two central dogs as the dance concludes. They reach their paws forward toward the viewer, creating a sense of interaction with the lens. Their bob-cut wigs bounce slightly with the physical movement. The lighting is consistent and bright, casting soft, realistic shadows on the light-colored paved ground beneath their feet.
